crew.hint: 1 tech per trade being relocated plus a helper when lines are long.

nodes.name: Utility & equipment relocations (heat pump, disconnect, lines)
nodes.trigger: Include when existing equipment or service lines sit in the addition footprint or on the tie-in wall (heat pump, electrical disconnect, meter, hose bibbs, vents).

duration.hint: 1 day for a single relocation; add a day per additional trade involved.

nodes.name: Retrofit demolition (interior areas outside the addition)
nodes.trigger: Include when scope modifies existing interior rooms before the addition begins (e.g. a shower swap in another bath, hall bath changes).

duration.hint: Scale with number of rooms disturbed.

crew.hint: Usually one 2-man trade crew at a time; 3 only when trades stack.

nodes.name: Retrofit rough MEPs
nodes.trigger: Include when the retrofit work moves or adds plumbing, electrical, or HVAC (a relocated shower valve, new circuits, moved ducts).

duration.hint: 1-2 days per trade involved; most retrofits touch one or two trades.

nodes.name: Retrofit rough inspection
nodes.trigger: Include whenever retro_rough_meps is included — moved rough MEPs must be inspected before cover.

nodes.name: Retrofit drywall & patching
nodes.trigger: Include when retrofit work opened walls or ceilings that need closing before the addition starts.

duration.hint: Hang/tape/sand cycle — 3 days minimum when any full sheets go up.

nodes.name: Retrofit finishes (paint, tile, flooring, fixtures)
nodes.trigger: Include when the retrofit scope has finish work — shower tile, paint, flooring, fixture sets. The retrofit completes FULLY before addition demo.

duration.hint: A full shower rebuild runs 5-8 days; paint-and-patch only runs 1-2.

crew.hint: Duration hint assumes a 3-man demo crew; drop to 2 for light site clearing.

nodes.name: Demolition (site + structure at addition footprint)
nodes.trigger: Include on every addition with any existing material to remove at the footprint — flatwork, decks, siding at tie-in, site obstructions. Nearly always included.

duration.hint: 1 day light site clearing; 3-4 days with concrete sawcut + structure removal.

nodes.name: Site prep (protection, staging, access)
nodes.notes: Deliberately overlaps demo's last day (FS -1) — site prep and excavation start the same day demo wraps.
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: 1 day standard; 2 if occupied-home protection is heavy.

crew.hint: Operator + laborer is the TCR standard dig crew.

nodes.name: Excavation (footings, slab, access)
nodes.notes: Rock is common in this area — hitting rock becomes a change order, not schedule padding.
nodes.trigger: Include whenever the addition needs new foundation work (nearly always). Exclude only for additions over existing slab/structure.

duration.hint: Scale with footprint and rock risk — Tri-Cities digs hit rock often.

crew.hint: Duration hint assumes a 4-man concrete crew — forming and pour days need all hands.

nodes.name: Foundation (form, inspect, pour)
nodes.trigger: Include whenever excavation is included — footings + slab or crawlspace walls per plan.

duration.hint: Monolithic slab ~3-4 days including footing inspection; crawlspace/basement walls push toward 7.

crew.hint: 3-man frame crew is the TCR baseline the duration hint assumes; two-story or heavy roof tie-in earns 4-5.

nodes.name: Framing (floor, walls, roof structure, sheathing)
nodes.notes: The 7-calendar-day gap after foundation is cure time before loading. Roof tie-in to existing structure carries concealed-condition risk — document day 1 of roof framing for fast change orders.
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: Single-story ~300sqft addition ~5-8 days; two-story or complex roof tie-in pushes 10-15.

nodes.name: Deck build
nodes.trigger: Include when scope includes a deck or porch attached to the addition.

duration.hint: Simple platform deck 2-3 days; large or railed/covered decks 5-8.

nodes.name: Exterior windows & doors install
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: ~3 windows/day including flashing.

crew.hint: Duration hint assumes 3; a full 5-man crew shingles a small addition in a day.

nodes.name: Roofing (underlayment, shingles, flashing, tie-in blend)
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: Small addition roof 1-2 days; complex tie-in to existing adds a day.

nodes.name: Siding (WRB, siding, tie-in blend)
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: ~250 sqft/day lap siding; matching existing adds time.

nodes.name: Fascia, soffit & gutters
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: Same crew as siding, continuous block.

nodes.name: Extend existing appliance vents through new roof
nodes.notes: Promoted from an escape-hatch catch on 308 Evergreen (2026-08-05) — the addition roof covered the existing gas WH vent path.
nodes.trigger: Include when existing appliance vents (water heater flue, furnace vent, range/dryer exhausts) pass through the new roof area and must be extended per code.

duration.hint: Half-day for a single flue; a day when multiple penetrations need flashing.

nodes.name: Rough plumbing
nodes.notes: If a water heater is in scope, it gets SET before rough-in begins — the rough-in stubs into the already-set tank.
nodes.trigger: Include when the addition adds any plumbing fixture (bath, kitchen, laundry, wet bar) or relocates lines.

duration.hint: ~4hr per fixture including supply + DWV; a full bath ~3 days.

nodes.name: Rough HVAC (line set / duct extension)
nodes.trigger: Include when the addition is conditioned space (nearly always) — mini-split line set or duct extension per scope.

duration.hint: Mini-split line set 1 day; duct extension 2-4.

nodes.name: Rough electrical (circuits, subpanel, boxes)
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: ~6 boxes/hour rough; subpanel adds half a day.

nodes.name: Rough inspections (MEPs then framing, bundled)
nodes.notes: Order within the visit is strict: MEP inspections first, framing LAST (trades drill the framing, so it isn't final until MEPs are in).
nodes.trigger: Always include — plumbing, electrical, HVAC and framing inspections, same day when possible, MEPs before framing.

duration.hint: Try for one day; plan 2 for scheduling reality.

nodes.name: Insulation & air sealing
nodes.notes: Planned +1 week after inspections pass. Game-day the PM often pulls it earlier the moment the framing inspection clears — that's a manual edit, not the plan.
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: Batts, 1 day typical for an addition.

nodes.name: Insulation inspection
nodes.trigger: Always include — next day after insulation.

crew.hint: The ~1-week duration assumes a 3-man hang/tape/sand crew.

nodes.name: Drywall (hang, tape, sand)
nodes.notes: No inspections block anything after the insulation inspection — from here the job flows on TCR's own pace until the final inspection at closeout.
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: ~1 week for a typical addition; scale with sqft + retrofit patching.

nodes.name: Paint phase 1 (prime + wall prep + ceilings)
nodes.trigger: Always include.

duration.hint: Mostly priming and wall fixing — 2 days typical.

crew.hint: One tile setter; a helper only on big multi-wall showers.

nodes.name: Shower work (waterproofing, tile, grout)
nodes.trigger: Include when the addition scope has a tile shower or tub surround.

duration.hint: Substrate 1d + set 2-4d + grout 1d for a custom shower.

crew.hint: ~250 sqft/day LVP pace is at a 2-man crew.

nodes.name: Hard flooring install (LVP, hardwood, tile floors)
nodes.notes: Starts on shower work's last day (1-day overlap) — on bigger houses the crews work different rooms.
nodes.trigger: Include when scope has hard-surface flooring (nearly always).

duration.hint: LVP ~250 sqft/day; hardwood slower.

nodes.name: Cabinets, counters, vanities & fixed items
nodes.notes: This is the 'things that ding walls and need no boots on new floors' block — bring-ins happen after hard flooring, before carpet.
nodes.trigger: Include when scope has cabinetry, vanities, counters, or other wall-dinging installs (commodes staged here too).

duration.hint: Vanity 0.5d; kitchen run 1.5d; counters add a template+install cycle.

nodes.name: Carpet & floating floors
nodes.trigger: Include when scope has carpet or floating floor areas.

duration.hint: 1 day typical for addition-scale carpet.

crew.hint: Max 2 interior trades on site at once — this crew number is per day, not total heads across the block.

nodes.name: Final trades (trim, interior doors, final E/P/M)
nodes.notes: Faucets into vanities, sink hookups, wall electronics — the final connect pass across every trade still on the job.
nodes.trigger: Always include — trim + interior doors + electrical/plumbing/HVAC finish in one coordinated block.

duration.hint: Trim 2-3d + each finish trade ~1d, staggered max 2 interior trades at once.

nodes.name: Stairs (build/finish)
nodes.trigger: Include when the addition has stairs (second story, basement access, split levels).

duration.hint: Finish carpentry on a straight run ~2 days.

nodes.name: Paint phase 2 (final coats)
nodes.trigger: Always include — final wall coats + trim paint after all trades are out.

duration.hint: 2 days typical.

nodes.name: Substantial completion
nodes.notes: Paint 2 finishing IS substantial completion — the client's 'done' moment. Closeout runs after; the project is functionally complete here.
nodes.trigger: auto

nodes.name: Concrete flatwork (patios, driveways, walkways)
nodes.trigger: Include when scope has exterior concrete work.

duration.hint: Form+pour+strip; scale with area.

nodes.name: Landscaping & site restoration
nodes.trigger: Always include — final grade, seed/straw, repair equipment damage. Merges with patio work when both exist.

duration.hint: 1-2 days restoration; real landscape scope pushes higher.

nodes.name: Customer walkthrough & punch list
nodes.trigger: Always include — 2 days after substantial completion.

nodes.name: Final inspections (building + E/P/M, bundled)
nodes.trigger: Always include.

nodes.name: Job complete (owner walkthrough with customer)
nodes.notes: Will personally closes every addition with the customer, one working day after the last item finishes — inspection AND landscaping both done.
nodes.trigger: auto

phases.name: Retrofit (pre-addition work)
phases.notes: Retro work on the EXISTING home completes FULLY before addition demo begins — its own mini-job including MEPs, inspection, and finishes. Empty on jobs with no pre-addition work.

phases.name: Demolition
phases.notes: True job start for the addition itself. Building permit must be delivered before demo begins (gate added automatically).

phases.name: Exterior Finishes
phases.notes: Anchored to windows/doors completion — NOT the whole framing phase end, because deck build runs parallel and nothing here waits on the deck.

phases.name: Rough Trades (MEPs)
phases.notes: Interior work begins only when the exterior is FULLY finished (siding, roofing, fascia, soffit all done) — current TCR practice, revisit later if we want MEPs to start at dried-in.

phases.name: Interior Finishes
phases.notes: Everything before this phase is tight and rushed — the whole project waits on each step. From here on, breathing room is OK and fewer mistakes happen. Don't panic-compress interior finishes.

phases.name: Concrete & Landscaping
phases.notes: Runs parallel with closeout — starts right after paint 2, independent of walkthrough.

permits.name: Building permit
permits.notes: Will gets permits same-day ~90% of the time — the 2-week application anchor is the safety margin, not the expectation. Demo never starts without it in hand.

permits.name: TDEC septic permit
permits.notes: ~6-week TDEC process: contact → soil scientist visit ($500 fee) → soil report → permit. Often the longest lead in the whole job; do NOT break ground without it.
permits.trigger: Include ONLY when the scope modifies the existing septic system or installs a new one. Adding bedrooms/bathrooms alone does NOT trigger it.

permits.name: Electrical service / meter permit
permits.notes: Utility coordination for service work can outrun the 2-week anchor — confirm with the utility early.
permits.trigger: Include when the job upgrades the main service or relocates the meter (utility + state inspection involvement). A subpanel alone does NOT trigger it — that rides the building permit.

permits.name: Land disturbance / stormwater permit
permits.trigger: Include when excavation disturbs enough ground to trip local stormwater rules (large footprint, steep lot, near a waterway) — rare on typical additions.

components.name: Deck
components.notes: Starts alongside framing and runs as its own parallel track — nothing downstream ever waits on the deck.

components.name: Cladding & Roof
components.notes: Roofing, siding, and fascia/soffit/gutters all start together and run in parallel.

components.name: Rough MEPs
components.notes: Plumbing → HVAC → electrical with 1-day overlaps: each next trade starts on the prior trade's last day.

components.name: Interior Installs
components.notes: Order matters: shower work → hard flooring → wall-dinging installs (cabinets/vanities/counters/commodes) → carpet last.

procurement.name: Windows & exterior doors
procurement.trigger: Always include. Order minimum 21 calendar days before demo; confirm custom vs stock with customer (custom runs 28-42).

delivery_time.hint: Stock 2-3 weeks; custom runs 4-6 weeks — confirm custom vs stock with the customer.

procurement.name: LVL / engineered beams
procurement.notes: Nominal 1-2 weeks but availability swings with the lumber market — early-order rather than halt framing.
procurement.trigger: Include when engineered structural members are on the project.

delivery_time.hint: Standard LVL ~1 week; pressure-treated or custom, or a tight lumber market, pushes 3 weeks.

procurement.name: Roof trusses (custom)
procurement.trigger: Include when the roof is trussed (not stick-framed).

delivery_time.hint: Truss plant queue drives it — bigger/complex roofs sit longer in engineering.

procurement.name: Subpanel / service equipment
procurement.notes: Existing main service amperage must be verified before contract — 200A is typical but panel space for the subpanel is the real question.
procurement.trigger: Include when a subpanel or service upgrade is in scope (verify amperage first).

procurement.name: HVAC equipment (mini-split / system)
procurement.trigger: Include when new HVAC equipment serves the addition.

delivery_time.hint: Common mini-splits ~1 week; matched ducted systems or specialty sizes push 3 weeks.

procurement.name: Water heater (tank or tankless)
procurement.trigger: Include when a NEW water heater is in scope (serving the addition or replacing existing). Extending an existing WH's vent does NOT trigger this.

delivery_time.hint: Stock tanks are days; tankless or specialty venting pushes 2 weeks.

procurement.name: Tile & setting materials
procurement.trigger: Include when tile is in scope.

delivery_time.hint: In-stock tile ~1 week; special-order or large custom showers push 3 weeks.

procurement.name: Hard flooring
procurement.notes: Ordering ties to USE date, not job start — interior finish materials wait until the shell is underway.
procurement.trigger: Include when hard flooring is in scope. Order ~3 weeks before install; deliver 2 weeks ahead of use.

procurement.name: Carpet / floating floor
procurement.trigger: Include when carpet or floating floors are in scope.

procurement.name: Cabinets / vanities
procurement.trigger: Include when cabinetry is in scope. Custom cabinets run 42-56 days — order at structural sign-off.

delivery_time.hint: Stock/semi-custom 3-4 weeks; full custom runs 6-8 weeks — order at structural sign-off.

procurement.name: Shower glass (template after tile)
procurement.trigger: Include when a glass shower enclosure is in scope.

delivery_time.hint: Template happens after tile — the window only starts once measurements exist.

procurement.name: Interior doors & trim package
procurement.trigger: Always include — interior doors, casing, base, and trim stock for the final trades block.

delivery_time.hint: Stock profiles ~1 week; special-order doors or matching existing profiles push 2 weeks.

procurement.name: Plumbing fixtures (faucets, sinks, commodes, shower trim)
procurement.trigger: Include when the addition adds plumbing fixtures (nearly always when a bath/kitchen is in scope).

delivery_time.hint: Stock fixtures are days; designer or specialty finishes push 3 weeks.

procurement.name: Light fixtures & devices
procurement.trigger: Always include — fixtures, fans, devices, and plates for electrical finish.

delivery_time.hint: Stock is days; customer-selected specialty fixtures push 3 weeks.
